correctness.rationale: The ratio of two independent centered Gaussians is Cauchy. Maximal-absolute-row pivoting maps its ratio to the interval (-1,1) with density 2/[pi(1+r^2)]; the untouched Gaussian second column remains conditionally iid standard normal after the first-column-measurable permutation. Thus the last pivot is exactly N(0,1+r^2) conditionally; integrating conditional moments establishes every stated moment. The algebra gives variance 4/pi, fourth moment 16/pi and kurtosis pi. Unpivoted last pivot has infinite second moment because E[1/a^2] diverges. The included checker replays exact coefficients and finite simulation; finite checks do not prove the infinite identity.

value.rationale: The entire even-moment sequence gives an exact, natural finite-dimensional benchmark for random GEPP, including a sharp contrast between infinite second moment without pivoting and finite variance/near-Gaussian fourth moment under partial pivoting. This quantitatively isolates the variance regularization effected by selecting the larger pivot on the smallest nontrivial matrix. The specific covariance and kurtosis are suited to checking random-pivot analysis and simulation; no high-dimensional or rounding-error conclusion is claimed.
